d: An anthropomorphic goat-like creature with a muscular build and an expression of stern maturity. The head features a dark charcoal snout, piercing gold eyes, and two long, curving black horns, topped with voluminous, wavy platinum white hair that cascades down the back and sides. The attire consists of a red and brown patterned sash across the chest, a decorative gold and brown waist belt with hanging fabric tabs, and leather straps wrapping the forearms and calves. Accessories include a spiked collar of black and gold, multi-colored woven armbands with small white fur tufts, and a large red crystalline blade held in the left hand. BODY COLOR: charcoal black LEGS: digitigrade with cloven hooves
